teacher_info.intro:
Hey language lovers! I'm a certified TESL teacher fluent in English, Tamil, Malay, and Indonesian. I'm also a language learner myself, currently tackling Mandarin and Korean. I love to travel and connect with people from different cultures. Let's learn and have fun together!

嗨，大家好！ 我是经过认证的TESL老师。
 
我精通多种语言，包括英文、泰米尔文、马来文和印度尼西亚文，目前正在学习中文和韩文。我喜欢学习新语言并结识新朋友。这也是我也喜欢旅行的原因之一！

안녕하세요 저는 공인된 TESL 선생님입니다.

저는 영어, 타밀, 말레이어, 인도네시아어를 다국어로 구사하고 있으며, 새로운 언어를 배우고 새로운 사람들을 만나는 것을 좋아하기 때문에 현재 만다린어와 한국어를 배우고 있습니다. 이것이 저 또한 여행을 좋아하는 이유 중 하나입니다!
teacher_info.short_signature: Certified 10 Years of Experience in Teaching
teacher_info.introduction: ABOUT ME -Hi everyone! I’m Yuwanes. I have a Degree in TESL. I have been teaching English and Malay to students and adults from beginners to advance level from around the globe. -I am a multi-lingual speaker of English, Tamil and Malay, and now learning Mandarin, Korean and Japanese as I find learning new languages fascinating. -Being raised in a multi-cultural society allows me to understand the cultural differences and learner’s needs for learning a new language. TEACHING STYLE -I focus on conversations as I believe that conversing is the most efficient way to learn a new language. -We can discuss any topic you like. Through this, I hope to expand your vocabulary, idioms, phrasal verbs and more. If there are any mistakes made such as pronunciation, grammar, word usage, etc, I will help to correct your mistakes. -Depending on your level and interest, I use various teaching resources such as videos and article to aid better listening and speaking. -For advanced speakers, I like to discuss topics that challenge learners. -You can have writing homework so we could discuss & analyze them -I am friendly, patient, and easy going who can talk about anything and quite versatile towards your learning needs and style. ENGLISH -I can help with both British English and American English from beginner to advanced learners from ages 8 and above. *If you are interested, I can also teach you English creole-based language, MANGLISH, and SINGLISH which is widely spoken in Malaysia and Singapore respectively. MALAY - Formal Malay is very different than informal Malay that native speakers use. -I teach both formal and colloquial Malay, including Malay for travelling from beginner to advanced learners. -For beginners, you will learn to read Malay in just one lesson. We will then continue with the basics of the language, where I will explain the usage and grammar. -For intermediate & advanced learners, let’s have conversations just like the native speakers! -I hope to see you soon!

My name is Roberto Andrade. I was born in Mexico but spent almost all of my childhood in the USA, which is why I consider myself a native Spanish and English speaker.

I'm a professional language teacher and musician who also has a passion for education through technology. I have taught English one-on-one for about five years here in Mexico and Spanish online for two years, helping students perfect their conversation, pronunciation and grammar skills and have even prepared some for job interviews. 

Some info about my lessons:

**BASIC SPANISH/ENGLISH LESSONS**: While I'm absolutely convinced that speaking is the ONLY way to master a language, it can be frustrating at first if you don't know the basics of how the language works. We will use a book and focus mostly of course on speaking but also basic grammar and pronunciation, always trying to apply it to real world situations. 

SPANISH/ENGLISH LESSONS: These lessons are for intermediate to advanced students who are struggling with certain grammar topics (Subjunctive, Por vs Para, Preterite vs Imperfect, etc..) and would like a semistructured approach. In addition to practicing conversation, we will do grammar exercises to help you practice these topics. Please send me a message telling me which topic you want to work on when booking a lesson.

INFORMAL TUTORING: *Only for intermediate and advanced speakers who can hold a conversation in the target language* We will focus 100% on speaking (in the target language only). This could be anything, day-to-day stuff, a video, an article, etc... Most of my students prefer to talk about their daily life as it gives them real life experience with the language. 

***CANCELLATION POLICY*** If you cancel less than 24 hours before your scheduled lesson, you will be charged for my time. If I need to cancel less than 24 hours before our lesson, I will return the credits to your account or return the lesson to the package.
